# Festuca microstachys Nutt.

First published in Proc. Acad. Nat. Sci. Philadelphia 4(Mar.-Apr.): 24 (1848)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is W. Canada to NW. Mexico, Guadalupe, Peru. It is an annual and grows primarily in the temperate biome.


## Distribution

  *   * KBD

### Native to:

Arizona, British Columbia, California, Colorado, Idaho, Mexican Pacific Is., Mexico Northwest, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Peru, Utah, Washington

### Introduced into:

Madeira, New York
